description: This file defines the OrganizationPaymentService class, which manages payment-related operations for organizations, including creating customers, handling pricing, subscriptions, and payment intents, and managing onboarding data.

classes.name: OrganizationPaymentService
classes.description: A service class that handles organization payment processes, including customer creation, pricing, subscription management, and onboarding updates.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the service with user context and optional permission service.

methods.name: getOrCreateStripeCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Stripe customer ID for a given email.

methods.name: normalizePaymentConfig
methods.description: Normalizes payment configuration input into a standard format.

methods.name: getUniqueTeamMembersCount
methods.description: Calculates the total unique members across specified teams and invited members.

methods.name: createOrganizationOnboarding
methods.description: Creates a new onboarding record for an organization after permission validation.

methods.name: getOrCreatePrice
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Stripe price based on the payment configuration.

methods.name: createSubscription
methods.description: Creates a Stripe subscription checkout session.

methods.name: validatePermissions
methods.description: Validates user permissions for payment modifications.

methods.name: createPaymentIntent
methods.description: Creates a payment intent and subscription for an organization, updating onboarding data accordingly.
